{{Quote|I've seen many different ways of making a photon fizzle, but no one did it better than Doodnik.|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
A '''photon fizzle''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] made with [[quanta]]. It was [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]] [[Doodnik's Café]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tyne's Horky]], and [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
{{Quote|We prepare ours the way he did, with just the right amount of regular or light quanta.|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
A photon fizzle was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] which could be made in a variety of different ways and was served at [[Restaurant/Legends|diners]] and [[Cafe/Legends|cafés]]. It was made with regular or light [[quanta]].<ref name="Dex" />

==History==
{{Quote|That was, uh, three, uh, Photon Fizzles.|C-3PO takes orders|<ref name="Droids" />}}
[[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] prepared the drink as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at [[Doodnik's Café]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tyne's Horky]]. Photon fizzles were also sold at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] Jettster later opened, [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], located on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> They could be purchased for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. In the menu, Jettster noted that he felt that the best photon fizzle was made by the owner of Doodnik's Café, [[Doodnik Sharpelz]]. Therefore, Jettster had his diner prepare their photon fizzles the way Sharpelz did, using the correct amount of regular or light quanta.<ref name="Dex" />

In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="date">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} establishes that the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'' takes place fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> photon fizzles were still [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] at Doodnik's Café. During the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] brief stint as an employee of the café, he was required to make three photon fizzles.<ref name="Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
Photon fizzles were first mentioned in "[[The Lost Prince]],"<ref name="Droids" /> the fifth episode of the animated series [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']], which first aired on [[October 5]], [[1985]].<ref name="ep date">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
